repo_notes.content: Phantom Secrets is a Rust workspace (crates/) that keeps real API keys out of AI agents' reach. The `phantom` CLI replaces .env secrets with `phm_` tokens, stores real values in an OS keychain or encrypted-file vault, and runs a localhost reverse proxy (127.0.0.1 only, never a forward/CONNECT proxy) that injects the route-owned vault value into an exact route's auth header. Crates: phantom-core (config, .env, tokens), phantom-vault (VaultBackend), phantom-proxy, phantom-cli, phantom-mcp (MCP server), plus fail-closed governed-execution foundations (phantom-workspace, -authority, -locus-contract, -broker, -runtime, -session, -evidence). Prefer diagrams for the exec/proxy request flow and crate dependencies. Link claims to source files; docs/architecture.md is the authoritative trust-boundary description.

Never document secret values, tokens or real home-directory paths; secrets are referenced by name only. Distinguish shipped behaviour from inactive fail-closed foundations (live provider issuance/rotation is hard-denied; production execution is not enabled).
